title.a: 誰能配得＋何等榮美的名
title.b: Who else + What A Beautiful Name

meta.author:
誰能配得：詞曲／Abbie Gamboa, Josiah Funderburk, Zac Rowe
何等榮美的名：詞曲／Ben Fielding & Brooke Ligertwood

lines.a: 我是敬拜器皿 尊崇讚美祢
lines.b: I am an instrument of exaltation

lines.a: 受造為了高舉祢名超乎萬名
lines.b: And I was born to lift Your name above all names

lines.a: 祢聽萬物宣揚 歌唱的旋律
lines.b: You hear the melody of all creation

lines.a: 但有首歌只有我能獻上給祢
lines.b: But there's a song of praise that only I can bring
Who else is worthy
Who else is worthy

lines.a: 無人配得 只有祢耶穌
lines.b: There is no one, only You Jesus
Who else is worthy
Who else is worthy

lines.a: 無人配得 只有祢耶穌
lines.b: There is no one, only You Jesus

lines.a: 祢是世世代代 永恆的上帝
lines.b: You are the infinite God of the ages

lines.a: 祢卻選擇我心為祢所在之地
lines.b: Yet You chose to make my heart Your dwelling place

lines.a: 醫治我的破碎 祢榮耀顯明
lines.b: You healed my brokenness, showed me Your glory

lines.a: 天使無法像我獻上感恩的心
lines.b: So I have songs of thanks not even angels sing
Lamb of God anointed one
Who was and is and is to come
Seated on the throne above
Holy, Holy
Righteous one who shed His blood
To prove to us the Father's love
Jesus Christ be lifted up
Holy, Holy
Lamb of God anointed one
Who was and is and is to come
Seated on the throne above
Holy, Holy
Righteous one who shed His blood
To prove to us the Father's love
Jesus Christ be lifted up

lines.a: 無人配得 只有祢耶穌
lines.b: There is no one, only You Jesus

lines.a: 死困不住祢 幔子已挪去
lines.b: Death could not hold You, the veil tore before You
You silenced the boast of sin and grave

lines.a: 與天堂歡慶 祢榮耀顯明
lines.b: The heavens are roaring the praise of Your glory
For You are raised to life again

lines.a: 祢無所匹敵 祢無人相比
lines.b: You have no rival, You have no equal
Now and forever, God, You reign

lines.a: 國度屬於祢 榮耀屬於祢
lines.b: Yours is the Kingdom, Yours is the glory
Yours is the name above all names
What a powerful name it is
What a powerful name it is
The name of Jesus Christ my King
What a powerful name it is
Nothing can stand against

lines.a: 這是何等大能的名 耶穌的聖名
lines.b: What a powerful name it is, the name of Jesus
